backend/main.mo: Defines actor types for users, rituals, pairing, love languages, challenges, and shared photos, including access control and storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report with no listed features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files describing components, pages, hooks, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base styles with OKLCH color tokens, light/dark theme variables, and shared UI styling rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting metadata, viewport, theme color, and mounting the app root.
frontend/QA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md: Manual QA checklist covering authentication, pairing, rituals, history states, and verification steps for core app flows.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app container managing authentication, profile setup, tab navigation, and query client setup.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Bottom navigation bar with tab icons, highlighting, and tab-switch handling.
frontend/src/components/CompletionAnimat: Floating heart animation component using memoized random generation for performance.
frontend/src/components/DataStates.tsx: Provides reusable UI components for loading, empty, error, section headers, and inline loading states.
frontend/src/components/HarmonyBreakdown: Displays harmony score, 7‑day trend sparkline, and related metrics with conditional explanations and data checks.
Shows a compact harmony summary button with current percent and trend, linking to insights.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Handles authentication with Internet Identity, showing login/logout states and loading feedback.
frontend/src/components/LoveChallenges.t: Renders a placeholder card announcing upcoming love challenges.
frontend/src/components/OurLoveLanguages: Card for viewing and updating love languages, with status, primary action, and shortcut to insights.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Guides users through entering their name and initializing their profile with loading, error, and success states.
frontend/src/components/RewardVisuals.ts: Displays placeholder milestone and progress visuals for a future rewards system.
frontend/src/components/SpinWheel.tsx: Interactive spinning wheel that selects a random love language with easing animation and daily spin persistence via localStorage.
frontend/src/components/UnlockPacks.tsx: Displays unlockable love‑language activity packs based on user streaks and quiz results, allowing selection of a pack.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth state, login/logout handling, and persists identities using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for user profiles, admin checks, pairing, and ritual-related backend calls.
frontend/src/index.css: Global styles and Tailwind setup defining a blush‑pink theme, dark mode, and several animation keyframes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point that mounts React, wrapping the app with react-query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/Activities.tsx: Displays activity components such as challenges, rewards, and spin wheel, gated by authentication and pairing unless admin.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Handles daily ritual flow including prompts, submissions, media upload, and history display with modals and animations.
frontend/src/pages/Insights.tsx: Shows relationship insights, streaks, harmony metrics, quiz alignment, and badge milestones with admin-aware gating.
frontend/src/pages/LoveLanguages.tsx: Implements the love languages quiz, mapping UI options to backend enums, saving results, and handling resets.
frontend/src/pages/Memories.tsx: Renders past ritual entries with expandable details, formatting dates, showing prompts, responses, and optional photos.
frontend/src/pages/Us.tsx: React page handling user–partner pairing flow, generating and completing 6‑digit codes with profile/admin checks and UI state management.
frontend/src/utils/harmony.ts: Utility functions for percent conversion, trend normalization, trend labeling, and mapping trend states to display metadata.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash‑based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, typography, container settings, animations, and custom theme tokens for the app.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing app architecture, features, and current implementation status including authentication, pairing, and analytics.
